judgments.reason: The HBN-EEG paper (Shirazi et al.) is the data descriptor for the BIDS-formatted HBN-EEG releases, and it shares authors and content (six tasks, HED annotations) with this Release 8 dataset.
judgments.paper_title: HBN-EEG: The FAIR implementation of the Healthy Brain Network (HBN) electroencephalography dataset

judgments.reason: Alexander et al. 2017 describes the overall Healthy Brain Network biobank initiative, which HBN-EEG Release 8 belongs to, not this specific EEG release.
judgments.paper_title: An open resource for transdiagnostic research in pediatric mental health and learning disorders

judgments.reason: Langer et al. 2017 describes the earlier 126-participant HBN pilot EEG/eye-tracking resource, not Release 8 of HBN-EEG; it is a related initiative paper.
judgments.paper_title: A resource for assessing information processing in the developing brain using EEG and eye tracking
